name: Halversen Trench No. 4
description:
Halversen is a Tier 3 label out of what used to be the Near North Side, producing precisely four coat designs and refusing to expand the line. The Trench No. 4 is a double-breasted belted trench in a mid-weight wool-poly blend, cut to knee length with a subtle A-line that works for most body types. The color options are camel, charcoal, and a dark green that Halversen calls 'meridian' on the label. Shoulder epaulettes, D-ring belt hardware, and a deep plaid lining in contrasting burgundy or navy. No tech. No gimmicks. Just a very well-made trench coat.

Halversen has a quiet following among Tier 3 professionals — architects, mid-level analysts, educators — who want something that looks considered without screaming corporate. The coat has been photographed enough on the street-feed aggregators that it carries a mild cachet, and resale prices hold steady. It buttons to the throat against wind and layers comfortably over a suit or a heavy sweater.
what_it_says: You have taste and you're not trying to prove it. You probably spent a while deciding on this and you'll wear it for ten years.
story_hooks: Halversen's founder died recently and left the brand to two estranged children who have very different visions for its future — one wants to sell to a corponation
A particular run of the Trench No. 4 in meridian green has a manufacturing defect in the lining that conceals a near-perfect hidden pocket — nobody knows if it was intentional
A Tier 4 executive was photographed wearing a knockoff of this coat and it sparked an unusual debate about authenticity and aspiration in the fashion feeds

physical_description.visual_profile: A classic double-breasted trench with restrained elegance—knee-length silhouette with subtle A-line flare at the hem. Structured shoulders anchored by functional epaulettes. The coat reads as intentional, professional without pretension: a garment that belongs in both a corporate atrium and a rain-soaked street market.
physical_description.fit: Tailored through the torso with controlled ease across the shoulders. The A-line cut accommodates various body types without clinging or ballooning. Sleeves are proportioned for layering; the belt cinches the waist without aggressive compression. Collar stands crisp and tall.
physical_description.primary_material: Mid-weight wool-poly blend—synthetic fibers for durability and weather resistance, natural wool for warmth and drape
physical_description.texture: Smooth face with subtle nap. Tightly woven to shed water. The lining is heavier, a soft brushed plaid that contrasts visually and tactilely with the exterior weave.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three colorways: warm camel (default), charcoal grey, and dark meridian green. Each features a deep burgundy or navy plaid lining visible at the lapels, collar, and cuffs.
physical_description.closures: Six-button double-breasted front (four functional, two decorative). Buckled belt with D-ring hardware in brushed steel or gunmetal. Wrist cuffs have button closures.
distinctive_features: Functional shoulder epaulettes with button-down straps
Welted patch pockets on the hip
Storm flap detail across the back yoke
Deep plaid lining in contrasting burgundy or navy
Structured, minimalist aesthetic—no logos, no integrated tech
Subtle brand label inside collar; hand-dated manufacturing code on the interior seam
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3—accessible premium. Not corpo luxury (Tier 1-2), not utilitarian street-wear (Tier 4-5). Signals education, professional stability, and deliberate taste.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mid-career professionals, educators, architects, and knowledge workers who reject both corpo conformity and studied anti-fashion posturing. Carries mild street cachet among discerning GLMZ residents. The wearer values longevity and craft over trend or augmentation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Arrives pristine with a center crease. After 1-2 seasons, develops a lived-in patina at the collar and cuffs. Wrinkles soften the structure in an appealing way. Cared-for examples show minimal wear; resale pieces hold their form and color.
